rules.note: Photocopy of a valid passport or national ID card clearly showing your name, citizenship and photograph.
Use SI's CV template, maximum three pages. Other formats, including Europass, lead to disqualification.
Proof of work and leadership experience on SI's form, typed, printed, signed by the referee, stamped by the organisation or a notary, and uploaded as one PDF.
Two reference letters from two different referees on SI's template, signed and stamped. One must be based on work experience; the other may be from work or outside engagements.
